tomas: Heads-up — onboarding OrpheusY-slim (int4) hit two separate conversion quirks: a block-head write-order (blocks of 3 interleaved) causing KV offset drift at long context, and an apostrophe normalization that collapsed U+2019 -> U+0027 leading to token id shadowing. Dropping triage notes.
anya: Numbers + convert command?
tomas: fp16 ppl 1.85, int4 pre-fix ppl 3.12. Convert used: `python tools/convert_model.py --src orpheusy --dst gemma --quant int4 --vocab-map maps/orpheusy_to_gemma.json --out /tmp/oys_int4`
kevin: Tokenmap sample around quote: `{"120":"120","121":"121","122":"39","123":"123"}` # src id 122 mapped -> 39 (ASCII apostrophe)
tomas: Head perm inferred by correlating rotary heads: pattern = blocks of 3 interleave -> perm builder worked: `B=3; perm=[]; for b in range(B): for i in range(H//B): perm.append(b + i*B)`; applying to rotary/qkv/o fixed positional drift.
anya: Did you try restoring original codepoints for the punctuation cluster?
tomas: Rewrote the small vocab mappings to keep U+2019 separate (made injectivity check for punctuation ranges). Combined fixes -> int4 ppl 1.90, long-context KV stress (4096) passes. Isolated: head-fix only -> ppl 2.05; vocab-fix only -> ppl 2.7.
kevin: Good. Can we add conversion flags `--repair-head-layout` and `--preserve-unicode` and a tiny CI microtest (seed 16 tokens) that compares attention-pos correlation to fp16 and fails if drop >8%? Also add model-catalog metadata fields `rotary_layout: block-3|contiguous|unknown` and `vocab_normalization: none|NFKC|other`.
tomas: Will open PR with the flags, detection heuristics (tools/check_head_blocks.py), tokenmap injectivity check, CI unit test, and exporter_git_sha logging. ops-bot: ticket INF-3307 created and assigned to tomas (P2).
